intent: What the user wants to build and why (1-2 sentences)
context: Current codebase/org context relevant to this spec

mustHaves.truth: A verifiable statement that must be true when complete
mustHaves.evidence: How to verify this truth (file path, test, behavior)
mustHaves.$comment: check is OPTIONAL — when present the verifier runs the command and the exit code becomes the primary evidence (expectExitCode defaults to 0)

tasks.description: Standalone task description — includes what, where, and connections

scopeBoundaries: Explicitly NOT included in this spec

assumptions.text: An assumption this spec relies on

$comment-loopCharter: loopCharter is OPTIONAL (null for quiet-default retries) — bounds for autonomous retry loops; also stored on the package at packages.type_data.loop_charter
